description.narrative: A transparent, effective, and long-term collaboration between civil society and other development actors that contributes to strengthened capacity and improved conditions for local civil society in relation to Swedish, European, and global processes.

participating-org.narrative: The Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida)

sector.narrative: All of our work with regard to development cooperation and sustainable development has end poverty and its targets as a key component.

As a platform of civil society organisations with partner organisations all over the world, inclusive societies, and its targets regarding accountable and transparens institutions, representative decision-making and participation in global governance, permeates our work

Our organization represents several civil society organizations in Sweden with various cooperations globally. Democratic participation and civil society lies at the core of our work, as it is a fundamental priority of ours. We consistently represent our members at meetings and gatherings to bring forth their opinions and our stance as the civil society. In addition, we inform our members about policy developments and current affairs impacting the civil society.

SDG 17 plays an equal key part of our work, with its targets on development assistance commitments, improve domestic resouce mobilization and financial resources, and in general promote policy coherence for sustainable development.

We coordinate a working group consisting of several member organisations to address and promote gender equality. The work with this particular SDG is done through exchanges of knowledge and expertise amongst members, as well as active moderation and guidance by CONCORD Sweden.

We coordniate a working group for our member organizations with a specific focus on climate justice. Here, we focus on committments prioritized by us and our members and exchange knowledge, as well as expertise for the purpose of capacity building.
